workarounds.symptom: A computer that opened codeaf once cannot join another: 'this computer has local work' with no chats
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Follow-ups to hosted storage opt-in: tools stop when a chat moves, closing sentences arrive, moved chats keep their words. Target files: cmd/codeaf/chatv3_layout.go, cmd/codeaf/chatv3_pair.go, cmd/codeaf/chatv3_surface.go. #2509 made hosted sync storage off until an account is approved. Testing it on two real computers (a Linux PC and a Mac) turned up the bugs below. Some come from #2509's storage-off roads, and some were already on `dev`. Each one has its own issue, with a replication anyone can run. (Ref: https://github.com/Agent-Field/CodeAF/pull/2536)
